Simple fix: make reputation fade when you go quiet. You start at 100 points, and after 2 idle epochs you lose 8 per epoch. Drop below 60 and you lose rewards. It's crystal clear: no parking a fake to cash in later.

You earn points back with real work, up to 6 per check, capped at 100. Copy someone's work and you drop to 20 and freeze for 6 epochs. The meadow stays green only if you keep tending it.

Now the math: 1,000 fakes cost 3,000 units per epoch to keep alive; one missed cycle wipes 8,000 points. The wharf test: no show, no sail. Honest agents pay nothing extra.
